query.name: com.cathedral.subapp.masterschedule
query.description: Returns distinct teacher/period/room/course/term combinations (with co-seated courses combined via LISTAGG) across all active terms in the school year corresponding to target_term.
query.sql: WITH DistinctClasses AS ( SELECT DISTINCT t.LASTFIRST, t.EMAIL_Addr, REPLACE(cc.expression, '(A)', '') AS period, t.EMAIL_Addr || '-' || REPLACE(cc.expression, '(A)', '') AS email_period_join, c.course_name, s.room, t.id AS teacher_id, cc.termid AS term_id FROM cc cc JOIN courses c ON c.course_number = cc.course_number JOIN teachers t ON cc.TEACHERID = t.id JOIN sections s ON cc.sectionid = s.id WHERE cc.termid > 0 AND FLOOR(cc.termid / 100) = FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(:target_term) / 100) ) SELECT LASTFIRST AS lastfirst, EMAIL_Addr AS email_addr, period AS period, email_period_join AS email_period_join, room AS room, LISTAGG(course_name, ' / ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY course_name) AS course_names, MAX(teacher_id) AS teacher_id, TO_CHAR(term_id) AS term_id FROM DistinctClasses GROUP BY LASTFIRST, EMAIL_Addr, period, email_period_join, room, term_id ORDER BY LASTFIRST, term_id

query.name: com.cathedral.subapp.bellschedule
query.summary: Cathedral Sub App - Bell Schedule & Calendar Days
query.description: Returns all weekday calendar days (Monday-Friday) for the school year corresponding to target_term, including in-session flag, cycle day name/letter, bell schedule name, and day note.

arg.name: target_term
arg.description: PowerSchool Term ID (e.g. 3600 or 3601) used to derive the 2-digit Year ID

column.description: 1 if school is in session, 0 if no school
Cycle Day Name (e.g. Green, Blue, Gold)

query.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(cd.date_value, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS calendar_date, cd.insession AS insession, cy.day_name AS cycle_day_name, cy.letter AS cycle_day_letter, bs.name AS bell_schedule_name, cd.note AS day_note FROM calendar_day cd JOIN terms tm ON tm.schoolid = cd.schoolid AND tm.isyearrec = 1 AND tm.yearid = FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(:target_term) / 100) AND cd.date_value BETWEEN tm.firstday AND tm.lastday LEFT JOIN cycle_day cy ON cy.id = cd.cycle_day_id LEFT JOIN bell_schedule bs ON bs.id = cd.bell_schedule_id WHERE cd.schoolid <> 0 AND (TRUNC(cd.date_value) - TRUNC(cd.date_value, 'IW')) BETWEEN 0 AND 4 ORDER BY cd.date_value ASC

query.name: com.cathedral.subapp.bellscheduletimes
query.summary: Cathedral Sub App - Bell Schedule Period Times
query.description: Returns exact start and end times for each period in each bell schedule for the school year corresponding to target_term.

arg.name: target_term
arg.description: PowerSchool Term ID (e.g. 3600 or 3601) used to derive the 2-digit Year ID

column.description: Start Time (seconds or minutes from midnight)
End Time (seconds or minutes from midnight)

query.sql: SELECT DISTINCT bs.name AS bell_schedule_name, p.abbreviation AS period_abbr, p.period_number AS period_number, bsi.start_time AS start_time, bsi.end_time AS end_time FROM bell_schedule_items bsi JOIN bell_schedule bs ON bs.id = bsi.bell_schedule_id JOIN period p ON p.id = bsi.period_id WHERE p.yearid = FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(:target_term) / 100) ORDER BY bs.name ASC, bsi.start_time ASC
